_comment: Researcher-only. Never shown to participants. A sentence error counts as FOUND when the participant marks that sentence with one of foundWhen. An omission counts as found when there is a 'missing' flag on its section (or on any sentence in it), or a 'missing' flag anywhere whose text contains one of keywords. 'unclear' on the target counts as NOTICED.

errors.label: Omission: new foot tingling
errors.whatIsWrong: The note leaves out the new tingling in her left foot and toes.
errors.whatWasSaid: For about two weeks my left foot has been tingling, mostly in the toes.

errors.label: Hallucination: past MRI
errors.whatIsWrong: No past MRI was discussed. Dr. Lee only said the Spine Center may want an MRI.

errors.label: Misattribution: heating pad
errors.whatIsWrong: Dr. Lee suggested the heating pad and stretching. Maria said she has not tried them.
errors.whatWasSaid: No, I haven't. I can try it.

errors.label: Wrong dose: gabapentin
errors.whatIsWrong: Only the bedtime dose goes up to 600 mg. Morning and afternoon stay at 300 mg.
errors.whatWasSaid: Raise your bedtime gabapentin to 600 milligrams. Keep taking 300 in the morning and afternoon.

errors.label: Wrong side: right leg
errors.whatIsWrong: The pain goes down her left leg, not her right.
errors.whatWasSaid: It's going down my left leg more.

errors.label: Softened pain: dull ache, 4/10
errors.whatIsWrong: She said about 6 most days and 8 on bad days, sharp and stabbing, not a dull ache.
errors.whatWasSaid: Most days it's about a 6. On bad days it's an 8. It's a sharp, stabbing pain, not just an ache.
